Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
The word of the Lord came to me again, saying,
耶和華的話又臨到我說：
“Now you, son of man, take up a lament for Tyre.
And you, son of man, make a song of grief for Tyre;
「人子啊，要為泰爾作起哀歌，
Tell Tyre, who dwells at the gateway to the sea, merchant of the peoples on many coasts, that this is what the Lord GOD says: You have said, O Tyre, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’

And say to Tyre, O you who are seated at the doorway of the sea, trading for the peoples with the great sea-lands, these are the words of the Lord: You, O Tyre, have said, I am a ship completely beautiful.
說：你居住海口，是眾民的商埠；你的交易通到許多的海島。主耶和華如此說：泰爾啊，你曾說：我是全然美麗的。
Your borders are in the heart of the seas; your builders perfected your beauty.
Your builders have made your outlines in the heart of the seas, they have made you completely beautiful.
你的境界在海中，造你的使你全然美麗。
They constructed all your planking with cypress from Senir. They took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
They have made all your boards of fir-trees from Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make the supports for your sails.
他們用示尼珥的松樹做你的一切板，用黎巴嫩的香柏樹做桅杆，
Of oaks from Bashan they made your oars; of wood from the coasts of Cyprus they made your deck, inlaid with ivory.
Of oak-trees from Bashan they have made your driving blades; they have made your floors of ivory and boxwood from the sea-lands of Kittim.
用巴珊的橡樹做你的槳，用象牙鑲嵌基提海島的黃楊木為坐板（或譯：艙板）。
Of embroidered fine linen from Egypt they made your sail, which served as your banner. Of blue and purple from the coasts of Elishah they made your awning.
The best linen with needlework from Egypt was your sail, stretched out to be a flag for you; blue and purple from the sea-lands of Elishah gave you shade.
你的篷帆是用埃及繡花細麻布做的，可以做你的大旗；你的涼棚是用以利沙島的藍色、紫色布做的。
The men of Sidon and Arvad were your oarsmen. Your men of skill, O Tyre, were there as your captains.
The people of Zidon and Arvad were your boatmen; the wise men of Zemer were in you; they were guiding your ships;
西頓和亞發的居民作你盪槳的。泰爾啊，你中間的智慧人作掌舵的。
The elders of Gebal were aboard as shipwrights, repairing your leaks. All the ships of the sea and their sailors came alongside to barter for your merchandise.
The responsible men of Gebal and its wise men were in you, making your boards watertight: all the ships of the sea with their seamen were in you trading in your goods.
迦巴勒的老者和聰明人都在你中間作補縫的；一切泛海的船隻和水手都在你中間經營交易的事。
Men of Persia, Lydia, and Put served as warriors in your army. They hung their shields and helmets on your walls; they gave you splendor.
Cush and Lud and Put were in your army, your men of war, hanging up their body-covers and head-dresses of war in you: they gave you your glory.
「波斯人、路德人、弗人在你軍營中作戰士；他們在你中間懸掛盾牌和頭盔，彰顯你的尊榮。
Men of Arvad and Helech manned your walls all around, and the men of Gammad were in your towers. They hung their shields around your walls; they perfected your beauty.
The men of Arvad in your army were on your walls, and were watchmen in your towers, hanging up their arms on your walls round about; they made you completely beautiful.
亞發人和你的軍隊都在你四圍的牆上，你的望樓也有勇士；他們懸掛盾牌，成全你的美麗。
Tarshish was your merchant because of your great wealth of goods; they exchanged silver, iron, tin, and lead for your wares.
Tarshish did business with you because of the great amount of your wealth; they gave silver, iron, tin, and lead for your goods.
「他施人因你多有各類的財物，就作你的客商，拿銀、鐵、錫、鉛兌換你的貨物。
Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your merchants. They exchanged slaves and bronze utensils for your merchandise.
Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders; they gave living men and brass vessels for your goods.
雅完人、土巴人、米設人都與你交易；他們用人口和銅器兌換你的貨物。
The men of Beth-togarmah exchanged horses, war horses, and mules for your wares.
The people of Togarmah gave horses and war-horses and transport beasts for your goods.
陀迦瑪族用馬和戰馬並騾子兌換你的貨物。
The men of Dedan were your clients; many coastlands were your market; they paid you with ivory tusks and ebony.
The men of Rodan were your traders: a great number of sea-lands did business with you: they gave you horns of ivory and ebony as an offering.
底但人與你交易，許多海島作你的碼頭；他們拿象牙、烏木與你兌換（或譯：進貢）。
Aram was your customer because of your many products; they exchanged turquoise, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies for your wares.
Edom did business with you because of the great number of things which you made; they gave emeralds, purple, and needlework, and the best linen and coral and rubies for your goods.
亞蘭人因你的工作很多，就作你的客商；他們用綠寶石、紫色布繡貨、細麻布、珊瑚、紅寶石兌換你的貨物。
Judah and the land of Israel traded with you; they exchanged wheat from Minnith, cakes and honey, oil and balm for your merchandise.
Judah and the land of Israel were your traders; they gave grain of Minnith and sweet cakes and honey and oil and perfume for your goods.
猶大和以色列地的人都與你交易；他們用米匿的麥子、餅、蜜、油、乳香兌換你的貨物。
Because of your many products and your great wealth of goods, Damascus traded with you wine from Helbon, wool from Zahar,
Damascus did business with you because of the great amount of your wealth, with wine of Helbon and white wool.
大馬士革人因你的工作很多，又因你多有各類的財物，就拿黑本酒和白羊毛與你交易。
and casks of wine from Izal for your wares. Wrought iron, cassia, and sweet cane were exchanged for your merchandise.
... for your goods: they gave polished iron and spices for your goods.
威但人和雅完人拿紡成的線、亮鐵、桂皮、菖蒲兌換你的貨物。
Dedan was your merchant in saddlecloths for riding.
Dedan did trade with you in cloths for the backs of horses.
底但人用高貴的毯子、鞍、屜與你交易。
Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your customers, trading in lambs, rams, and goats.
Arabia and all the rulers of Kedar did business with you; in lambs and sheep and goats, in these they did business with you.
阿拉伯人和基達的一切首領都作你的客商，用羊羔、公綿羊、公山羊與你交易。
The merchants of Sheba and Raamah traded with you; for your wares they exchanged gold, the finest of all spices, and precious stones.
The traders of Sheba and Raamah did trade with you; they gave the best of all sorts of spices and all sorts of stones of great price and gold for your goods.
示巴和拉瑪的商人與你交易，他們用各類上好的香料、各類的寶石，和黃金兌換你的貨物。
Haran, Canneh, and Eden traded with you, and so did the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad.
Haran and Canneh and Eden, the traders of Asshur and all the Medes:
哈蘭人、干尼人、伊甸人、示巴的商人，和亞述人、基抹人與你交易。
In your marketplace they traded with you fine garments of blue, embroidered work, and multicolored rugs with cords tightly twisted and knotted.
These were your traders in beautiful robes, in rolls of blue and needlework, and in chests of coloured cloth, corded with cords and made of cedar-wood, in them they did trade with you.
這些商人以美好的貨物包在繡花藍色包袱內，又有華麗的衣服裝在香柏木的箱子裡，用繩捆著與你交易。
The ships of Tarshish carried your merchandise. And you were filled with heavy cargo in the heart of the sea.
Tarshish ships did business for you in your goods: and you were made full, and great was your glory in the heart of the seas.
他施的船隻接連成幫為你運貨，你便在海中豐富極其榮華。
Your oarsmen have brought you onto the high seas, but the east wind will shatter you in the heart of the sea.
Your boatmen have taken you into great waters: you have been broken by the east wind in the heart of the seas.
盪槳的已經把你盪到大水之處，東風在海中將你打破。

Your wealth, wares, and merchandise, your sailors, captains, and shipwrights, your merchants and all the warriors within you, with all the other people on board, will sink into the heart of the sea on the day of your downfall.

Your wealth and your goods, the things in which you do trade, your seamen and those guiding your ships, those who make your boards watertight, and those who do business with your goods, and all your men of war who are in you, with all who have come together in you, will go down into the heart of the seas in the day of your downfall.
你的資財、物件、貨物、水手、掌舵的、補縫的、經營交易的，並你中間的戰士和人民，在你破壞的日子必都沉在海中。
The countryside will shake when your sailors cry out.
At the sound of the cry of your ships' guides, the boards of the ship will be shaking.
你掌舵的呼號之聲一發，郊野都必震動。
All who handle the oars will abandon their ships. The sailors and all the captains of the sea will stand on the shore.
And all the boatmen, the seamen and those who are expert at guiding a ship through the sea, will come down from their ships and take their places on the land;
凡盪槳的和水手，並一切泛海掌舵的，都必下船登岸。
They will raise their voices for you and cry out bitterly. They will throw dust on their heads and roll in ashes.
And their voices will be sounding over you, and crying bitterly they will put dust on their heads, rolling themselves in the dust:
他們必為你放聲痛哭，把塵土撒在頭上，在灰中打滾；
They will shave their heads for you and wrap themselves in sackcloth. They will weep over you with anguish of soul and bitter mourning.
And they will have the hair of their heads cut off because of you, and will put haircloth on their bodies, weeping for you with bitter grief in their souls, even with bitter sorrow.
又為你使頭上光禿，用麻布束腰，號咷痛哭，苦苦悲哀。
As they wail and mourn over you, they will take up a lament for you: ‘Who was ever like Tyre, silenced in the middle of the sea?
And in their weeping they will make a song of grief for you, sorrowing over you and saying, Who is like Tyre, who has come to an end in the deep sea?
他們哀號的時候，為你作起哀歌哀哭，說：有何城如泰爾？有何城如他在海中成為寂寞的呢？
When your wares went out to sea, you satisfied many nations. You enriched the kings of the earth with your abundant wealth and merchandise.
When your goods went out over the seas, you made numbers of peoples full; the wealth of the kings of the earth was increased with your great wealth and all your goods.
你由海上運出貨物，就使許多國民充足；你以許多資財、貨物使地上的君王豐富。
Now you are shattered by the seas in the depths of the waters; your merchandise and the people among you have gone down with you.
Now that you are broken by the seas in the deep waters, your goods and all your people will go down with you.
你在深水中被海浪打破的時候，你的貨物和你中間的一切人民，就都沉下去了。
All the people of the coastlands are appalled over you. Their kings shudder with fear; their faces are contorted.
All the people of the sea-lands are overcome with wonder at you, and their kings are full of fear, their faces are troubled.
海島的居民為你驚奇；他們的君王都甚恐慌，面帶愁容。
Those who trade among the nations hiss at you; you have come to a horrible end and will be no more.’”
Those who do business among the peoples make sounds of surprise at you; you have become a thing of fear, you have come to an end for ever.
各國民中的客商都向你發嘶聲；你令人驚恐，不再存留於世，直到永遠。」
